questions.question:
[지문]
Hello, everyone. My name is David Parker, and I'm a photographer. Today, I'm going to tell you how I found my dream and realized it. I hope my story can inspire you. When I was young, I loved stars. I also liked taking pictures. However, I never thought these things could lead to a job. In fact, I didn't have a dream at all. When I had to decide on a major in college, I chose engineering. Being an engineer looked OK. After college, I got a job at an engineering company. It was a stable job, but I didn't know if I really enjoyed it. Everything changed when I went on vacation to Iceland one winter. There I got a chance to see the Northern Lights. The lights were amazing, and I took many pictures of the dancing lights in the sky. For the first time in many years, I could feel my heart beat fast. After I came back, I entered a photo contest with the pictures I took in Iceland. Surprisingly, I won first prize, and this gave me a chance to think about my life. (A) I realized that taking pictures made me happy. (B) Suddenly, I wanted to become a good photographer, so I started to learn more about photography. (C) After years of trial and error, I got better, and I began to do some part-time work as a photographer. (D) I quit my job and decided to take pictures for a living. I wasn't sure if I could succeed, but I decided to try. (E) I really wanted to do something that made me happy. Now, I'm a professional photographer, and I'm happy.

윗글에 근거하여 David Parker의 조언에 들어갈 말로 적절하게 짝지어진 것은? David Parker's Advice: 1. Follow you ___ⓐ___. Think about what you like to do and what makes you happy. 2. Work hard. Pursuing a ___ⓑ___ is not easy. 3. Be bold. You need ___ⓒ___ to make decisions that will change your ___ⓓ___.
questions.explanation: 본문에서 'follow your heart(마음을 따르라)', 'Pursuing a dream(꿈을 추구하는 것)', 'courage to make decisions(결정에 필요한 용기)', 'change your life(당신의 인생을 바꾼다)'라는 표현이 나온다.

questions.question: 주어진 우리말을 영작할 때, <보기>의 단어들을 배열하는 순서에서 다섯 번째로 오는 단어는? 그 케이크를 자를 칼이 없다. → There is _________________________. <보기> with, knife, no, the, to, cut, cake
questions.explanation: 정답은 'There is no knife to cut the cake with.'이다. 단어 순서는 1.no 2.knife 3.to 4.cut 5.the 6.cake 7.with이므로 다섯 번째는 'the'이다.

questions.question: 다음 영어 뜻과 일치하는 단어들의 조합으로 알맞은 것은? (a) a person who is very skilled at doing something (b) to work hard in order to achieve something (c) staying the same, with no big changes or problems
questions.explanation: (a)의 뜻은 expert(전문가), (b)의 뜻은 pursue(추구하다), (c)의 뜻은 stable(안정적인)이다.

options: His hobby is to draw a picture.
She quit her job to go to Brazil.
I have enough time to finish my project.
He went to America to study engineering.
To be an expert is not easy for my sister.
questions.question: 밑줄 친 ⓐ와 같은 용법으로 사용된 것은? In Iceland I got a chance ⓐto see the Northern Lights.
questions.explanation: 밑줄 친 ⓐ의 'to see'는 '~하다'는 의미의 부정사로 '기회'를 수식한다. 같은 용법은 'to go to Brazil'로, 목적을 나타내는 부정사이다.

options: Judy isn't sure whether she is going in the right direction.
Sue is wondering if there's a pizza shop at the airport.
Harry didn't know who the gift gave to him.
Sue wants to know when Bob went to the gym.
Ally wonders if or not Dave will come to the party.
questions.question: 어법상 틀린 문장을 두 개 고르시오.
questions.explanation: ③ 'who the gift gave to him'은 'who gave the gift to him'이어야 한다. 간접의문문에서 주어와 동사의 어순이 바뀌어야 한다. ⑤ 'if or not'은 'whether or not'으로 써야 한다.

questions.question:
[지문]
I quit my job and decided to take pictures for a living. I wasn't sure if I could succeed, but I made a decision. I really wanted to do something that made me happy. Now, I do what I want to do, and I'm happy. So do you want to find a dream and realize it? Here's some (A) advise / advice to help you. First, ㉠________. your heart. Think about what you like to do and what makes you happy. In my case, it was taking pictures of stars. Second, ㉡________. Pursuing a dream is not easy. I became a (B) photography / photographer through hard work. Third, ㉢________. You need courage to make decisions that will change your life. I was afraid but I took a chance. I truly hope you can find a dream, (C) pursue / pursuit it, and live it!

(A)~(C)에 들어갈 말로 문맥상 가장 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: (A) advice는 '조언(명사)'이고 advise는 '조언하다(동사)'이므로 here's some + 명사 구조에서 advice가 맞다. (B) 'I became a ~'에는 photographer(명사)가 맞다. (C) 'pursue it'의 동사 형태 pursue가 맞다.

다음 글의 흐름상 <보기>의 문장들을 순서대로 배열한 것은? <보기> ⓐ be bold ⓑ work hard ⓒ follow your heart
questions.explanation: 글의 흐름상 'First, follow your heart(㉠ ⓒ)', 'Second, work hard(㉡ ⓑ)', 'Third, be bold(㉢ ⓐ)'의 순서로 배열되어야 한다.
